items.title: Digital Realty (DLR): Can a Data Center Landlord Become the Control Panel for Enterprise AI?
items.summary: On September 15, Digital Realty (NYSE:DLR) made ServiceFabric MCP available, a software layer that lets AI agents design, monitor and troubleshoot network connections across more than 800 data centers, including third-party sites. That nudges a real estate company toward becoming a control panel for enterprise AI. It arrives after second quarter results reported on July […]

items.title: How Far Can Cipher Digital Stock Fall While It Waits For Rent?
items.summary: Cipher Digital (CIFR) stock fell 36.2% over the past three months. Over twelve months it is still up 54.1%, against 15.5% for the S&P 500. The company is moving from bitcoin mining to leasing data centers to hyperscale tenants. In past market shocks, the stock fell hard and bounced back fast.

items.title: Digital Realty Trust (DLR) Forms Türkiye Venture. Does Secured Power Justify the Commitment?
items.summary: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE:DLR) announced a joint venture with Rönesans Infrastructure on September 14 to develop and operate data centers in Türkiye. The first Ankara campus is designed for more than 22 megawatts of IT capacity. Land, power and permits are secured, early construction has begun, and the first facility is scheduled for completion […]

items.title: Digital Realty Expands Into Turkiye With Strategic Data Center JV
items.summary: DLR enters Turkiye with Ronesans, launching a 22MW+ Ankara campus and planning an Istanbul expansion to meet rising cloud and AI demand.

items.title: Texas and Cape Town Are Tightening the Data-Center Gate. Digital Realty and Equinix Could Still Benefit
items.summary: The AI data-center boom is running into the same two scarce resources in very different places: power and political permission. Texas ordered a broad audit of projects in ERCOT’s 474-gigawatt interconnection queue in August.
